ai_contribution_suggestions_intent_shape.name: ai_contribution_suggestions_intent_shape
ai_contribution_suggestions_intent_shape.value:
("aiContributionSuggestions"."intent" = 'new_term'
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."definitionId" IS NULL
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."sourceRevisionId" IS NULL)
          OR ("aiContributionSuggestions"."intent" = 'revise_definition'
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."definitionId" IS NOT NULL
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."sourceRevisionId" IS NOT NULL
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."feedback" IS NOT NULL
            AND btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."feedback") <> '')

ai_contribution_suggestions_decision_sha.name: ai_contribution_suggestions_decision_shape
ai_contribution_suggestions_decision_sha.value:
("aiContributionSuggestions"."status" = 'generated'
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."outputDefinitionId" IS NULL
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."decidedAt" IS NULL)
          OR ("aiContributionSuggestions"."status" = 'accepted'
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."outputDefinitionId" IS NOT NULL
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."decidedAt" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("aiContributionSuggestions"."status" = 'discarded'
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."outputDefinitionId" IS NULL
            AND "aiContributionSuggestions"."decidedAt" IS NOT NULL)

ai_contribution_suggestions_nonblank.name: ai_contribution_suggestions_nonblank
ai_contribution_suggestions_nonblank.value:
btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."termText") <> ''
          AND char_length("aiContributionSuggestions"."termText") <= 200
          AND btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."suggestedDefinition") <> ''
          AND char_length("aiContributionSuggestions"."suggestedDefinition") <= 10000
          AND btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."promptKey") <> ''
          AND btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."promptHash") <> ''
          AND btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."promptText") <> ''
          AND btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."model") <> ''
          AND ("aiContributionSuggestions"."feedback" IS NULL
            OR (btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."feedback") <> ''
              AND char_length("aiContributionSuggestions"."feedback") <= 4000))
          AND ("aiContributionSuggestions"."inputDefinition" IS NULL
            OR (btrim("aiContributionSuggestions"."inputDefinition") <> ''
              AND char_length("aiContributionSuggestions"."inputDefinition") <= 10000))

ai_models_nonblank.name: ai_models_nonblank
ai_models_nonblank.value:
btrim("aiModels"."tag") <> '' AND btrim("aiModels"."vendor") <> ''
          AND ("aiModels"."family" IS NULL OR btrim("aiModels"."family") <> '')
          AND ("aiModels"."parameterSize" IS NULL OR btrim("aiModels"."parameterSize") <> '')

comments_human_carries_no_stamp.name: comments_human_carries_no_stamp
comments_human_carries_no_stamp.value:
"comments"."authorKind" <> 'human'
          OR ("comments"."promptKey" IS NULL AND "comments"."promptHash" IS NULL
              AND "comments"."promptText" IS NULL AND "comments"."model" IS NULL)

contribution_files_size.name: contribution_files_size
contribution_files_size.value: "contributionFiles"."byteSize" > 0 AND "contributionFiles"."byteSize" <= 5242880 AND (("contributionFiles"."assetId" IS NULL AND "contributionFiles"."bytes" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("contributionFiles"."bytes") = "contributionFiles"."byteSize") OR ("contributionFiles"."assetId" IS NOT NULL AND "contributionFiles"."bytes" IS NULL))

contribution_files_metadata.name: contribution_files_metadata
contribution_files_metadata.value: btrim("contributionFiles"."title") <> '' AND char_length("contributionFiles"."title") <= 200 AND btrim("contributionFiles"."caption") <> '' AND char_length("contributionFiles"."caption") <= 2000 AND char_length("contributionFiles"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND char_length("contributionFiles"."termText") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND ("contributionFiles"."citation" IS NULL OR char_length("contributionFiles"."citation") <= 1000) AND ("contributionFiles"."page" IS NULL OR char_length("contributionFiles"."page") <= 100)

contribution_files_publication.name: contribution_files_publication
contribution_files_publication.value: ("contributionFiles"."publishedRevisionId" IS NULL AND "contributionFiles"."publishedAt" IS NULL AND "contributionFiles"."exampleId" IS NULL) OR ("contributionFiles"."publishedRevisionId" IS NOT NULL AND "contributionFiles"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "contributionFiles"."publishedAt" >= "contributionFiles"."createdAt" AND (("contributionFiles"."role" = 'source' AND "contributionFiles"."exampleId" IS NULL) OR ("contributionFiles"."role" = 'example' AND "contributionFiles"."exampleId" IS NOT NULL)))

definition_example_selections_actor_or_l.name: definition_example_selections_actor_or_legacy
definition_example_selections_actor_or_l.value:
("definitionExampleSelections"."legacyBackfill" AND "definitionExampleSelections"."selectedById" IS NULL)
          OR (NOT "definitionExampleSelections"."legacyBackfill" AND "definitionExampleSelections"."selectedById" IS NOT NULL)

definition_example_selections_end_pair.name: definition_example_selections_end_pair
definition_example_selections_end_pair.value:
("definitionExampleSelections"."endedAt" IS NULL AND "definitionExampleSelections"."endedById" IS NULL)
          OR ("definitionExampleSelections"."endedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "definitionExampleSelections"."endedById" IS NOT NULL)

definition_examples_attribution_complete.name: definition_examples_attribution_complete_or_legacy
definition_examples_attribution_complete.value:
("definitionExamples"."legacyBackfill"
            AND "definitionExamples"."authorId" IS NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."actorKind" IS NULL)
          OR (NOT "definitionExamples"."legacyBackfill"
            AND "definitionExamples"."authorId" IS NOT NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."actorKind" IS NOT NULL)

definition_examples_generation_stamp.name: definition_examples_generation_stamp
definition_examples_generation_stamp.value:
("definitionExamples"."promptHash" IS NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."promptText" IS NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."model" IS NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."promptKey" IS NULL)
          OR ("definitionExamples"."promptHash" IS NOT NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."promptText" IS NOT NULL
            AND "definitionExamples"."model" IS NOT NULL
            AND btrim("definitionExamples"."promptHash") <> ''
            AND btrim("definitionExamples"."promptText") <> ''
            AND btrim("definitionExamples"."model") <> ''
            AND ("definitionExamples"."promptKey" IS NULL OR btrim("definitionExamples"."promptKey") <> ''))

definition_revisions_predecessor_shape.name: definition_revisions_predecessor_shape
definition_revisions_predecessor_shape.value:
("definitionRevisions"."version" = 1 AND "definitionRevisions"."previousRevisionId" IS NULL)
          OR ("definitionRevisions"."version" > 1 AND "definitionRevisions"."previousRevisionId" IS NOT NULL)

definition_revisions_complete_or_legacy.name: definition_revisions_complete_or_legacy
definition_revisions_complete_or_legacy.value:
"definitionRevisions"."legacyIncomplete"
          OR ("definitionRevisions"."exampleDiff" IS NOT NULL
              AND "definitionRevisions"."editorId" IS NOT NULL
              AND "definitionRevisions"."changeNote" IS NOT NULL)

definition_revisions_nonblank_optional_t.name: definition_revisions_nonblank_optional_text
definition_revisions_nonblank_optional_t.value:
("definitionRevisions"."exampleDiff" IS NULL
          OR (jsonb_typeof("definitionRevisions"."exampleDiff") = 'array'
              AND jsonb_array_length("definitionRevisions"."exampleDiff") > 0))
          AND ("definitionRevisions"."changeNote" IS NULL OR btrim("definitionRevisions"."changeNote") <> '')

definitions_author_term_original_unique.name: definitions_author_term_original_unique
definitions_author_term_original_unique.where:
"definitions"."refinedFromId" IS NULL
            AND "definitions"."replacesDefinitionId" IS NULL
            AND "definitions"."creationSurveyStepId" IS NULL

discussion_suggestions_acceptance_pair.name: discussion_suggestions_acceptance_pair
discussion_suggestions_acceptance_pair.value:
("discussionSuggestions"."acceptedAt" IS NULL AND "discussionSuggestions"."outputDefinitionId" IS NULL)
          OR ("discussionSuggestions"."acceptedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "discussionSuggestions"."outputDefinitionId" IS NOT NULL)

discussion_suggestions_nonblank_content.name: discussion_suggestions_nonblank_content
discussion_suggestions_nonblank_content.value:
btrim("discussionSuggestions"."comment") <> ''
          AND btrim("discussionSuggestions"."suggestedDefinition") <> ''
          AND btrim("discussionSuggestions"."suggestedExample") <> ''
          AND btrim("discussionSuggestions"."model") <> ''
          AND btrim("discussionSuggestions"."prompt") <> ''

matcore_draft_profile_pair.name: matcore_draft_profile_pair
matcore_draft_profile_pair.value: ("matcoreSpecDrafts"."profileKey" IS NULL) = ("matcoreSpecDrafts"."profileReleaseId" IS NULL) AND ("matcoreSpecDrafts"."sourceOccurrenceId" IS NULL OR "matcoreSpecDrafts"."profileKey" IS NOT NULL)

matcore_revision_profile_pair.name: matcore_revision_profile_pair
matcore_revision_profile_pair.value: ("matcoreSpecRevisions"."profileKey" IS NULL) = ("matcoreSpecRevisions"."profileReleaseId" IS NULL) AND ("matcoreSpecRevisions"."sourceOccurrenceId" IS NULL OR "matcoreSpecRevisions"."profileKey" IS NOT NULL)

matcore_revision_predecessor.name: matcore_revision_predecessor
matcore_revision_predecessor.value: ("matcoreSpecRevisions"."version" = 1 AND "matcoreSpecRevisions"."previousRevisionId" IS NULL) OR ("matcoreSpecRevisions"."version" > 1 AND "matcoreSpecRevisions"."previousRevisionId" IS NOT NULL)

site_feedback_page_path_shape.name: site_feedback_page_path_shape
site_feedback_page_path_shape.value:
char_length("siteFeedback"."pagePath") > 0
          AND left("siteFeedback"."pagePath", 1) = '/'
          AND left("siteFeedback"."pagePath", 2) <> '//'
          AND position(chr(92) in "siteFeedback"."pagePath") = 0
          AND position('?' in "siteFeedback"."pagePath") = 0
          AND position('#' in "siteFeedback"."pagePath") = 0
          AND "siteFeedback"."pagePath" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

site_feedback_resolution_shape.name: site_feedback_resolution_shape
site_feedback_resolution_shape.value:
("siteFeedback"."status" = 'open'
            AND "siteFeedback"."resolvedAt" IS NULL
            AND "siteFeedback"."resolvedByUserId" IS NULL)
          OR ("siteFeedback"."status" = 'resolved'
            AND "siteFeedback"."resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL)

source_extractions_input.name: source_extractions_input
source_extractions_input.value: "sourceExtractions"."fileId" IS NOT NULL OR "sourceExtractions"."assetId" IS NOT NULL

source_extractions_result.name: source_extractions_result
source_extractions_result.value: "sourceExtractions"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("sourceExtractions"."text" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("sourceExtractions"."text") <> '' AND "sourceExtractions"."textHash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "sourceExtractions"."pages" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceExtractions"."completedAt" IS NOT NULL)

statements_concept_link_unique.name: statements_concept_link_unique
statements_concept_link_unique.where: "statements"."retractedAt" IS NULL AND "statements"."predicate" = 'skos:exactMatch' AND "statements"."objectTermId" IS NOT NULL

statements_term_link_unique.name: statements_term_link_unique
statements_term_link_unique.where: "statements"."retractedAt" IS NULL AND "statements"."predicate" = 'skos:exactMatch' AND "statements"."objectTermId" IS NOT NULL

statements_predicate_shape.name: statements_predicate_shape
statements_predicate_shape.value:
CASE "statements"."predicate"
      WHEN 'dcterms:subject' THEN ("statements"."subjectTermId" IS NOT NULL OR "statements"."subjectDefinitionId" IS NOT NULL) AND "statements"."objectConceptId" IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'skos:member'     THEN "statements"."subjectCollectionId" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."objectTermId" IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'skos:broader'    THEN ("statements"."subjectTermId" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."objectTermId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("statements"."subjectConceptId" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."objectConceptId" IS NOT NULL)
      WHEN 'skos:related'    THEN ("statements"."subjectTermId" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."objectTermId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("statements"."subjectConceptId" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."objectConceptId" IS NOT NULL)
      WHEN 'skos:exactMatch' THEN (("statements"."subjectTermId" IS NOT NULL OR "statements"."subjectConceptId" IS NOT NULL) AND "statements"."objectIri" IS NOT NULL) OR ("statements"."subjectConceptId" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."objectTermId" IS NOT NULL)
      ELSE ("statements"."subjectTermId" IS NOT NULL OR "statements"."subjectConceptId" IS NOT NULL) AND "statements"."objectIri" IS NOT NULL
    END

statements_no_self_relation.name: statements_no_self_relation
statements_no_self_relation.value:
("statements"."subjectTermId" IS NULL OR "statements"."objectTermId" IS NULL OR "statements"."subjectTermId" <> "statements"."objectTermId")
       AND ("statements"."subjectConceptId" IS NULL OR "statements"."objectConceptId" IS NULL OR "statements"."subjectConceptId" <> "statements"."objectConceptId")

studies_window_ordered.name: studies_window_ordered
studies_window_ordered.value: "studies"."opensAt" IS NULL OR "studies"."closesAt" IS NULL OR "studies"."closesAt" > "studies"."opensAt"

study_definition_exclusions_restoration_.name: study_definition_exclusions_restoration_valid
study_definition_exclusions_restoration_.value:
("study_definition_exclusions"."restoredAt" IS NULL AND "study_definition_exclusions"."restoredById" IS NULL AND "study_definition_exclusions"."restorationReason" IS NULL)
      OR ("study_definition_exclusions"."restoredAt" IS NOT NULL AND "study_definition_exclusions"."restoredById" IS NOT NULL
        AND "study_definition_exclusions"."restorationReason" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(btrim("study_definition_exclusions"."restorationReason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
        AND "study_definition_exclusions"."restoredAt" >= "study_definition_exclusions"."excludedAt")

survey_responses_human_carries_no_stamp.name: survey_responses_human_carries_no_stamp
survey_responses_human_carries_no_stamp.value:
"surveyResponses"."authorKind" <> 'human'
          OR ("surveyResponses"."promptKey" IS NULL AND "surveyResponses"."promptHash" IS NULL
              AND "surveyResponses"."promptText" IS NULL AND "surveyResponses"."model" IS NULL)

survey_steps_prompt_by_kind.name: survey_steps_prompt_by_kind
survey_steps_prompt_by_kind.value:
"surveySteps"."kind" NOT IN ('instructions', 'question')
          OR ("surveySteps"."prompt" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("surveySteps"."prompt") <> '')

tag_suggestions_nonblank_content.name: tag_suggestions_nonblank_content
tag_suggestions_nonblank_content.value:
btrim("tagSuggestions"."label") <> ''
          AND ("tagSuggestions"."scopeNote" IS NULL OR btrim("tagSuggestions"."scopeNote") <> '')

tag_suggestions_nonblank_optional_text.name: tag_suggestions_nonblank_optional_text
tag_suggestions_nonblank_optional_text.value:
("tagSuggestions"."reviewReasons" IS NULL OR btrim("tagSuggestions"."reviewReasons") <> '')
          AND ("tagSuggestions"."decisionNote" IS NULL OR btrim("tagSuggestions"."decisionNote") <> '')
          AND ("tagSuggestions"."reviewError" IS NULL OR btrim("tagSuggestions"."reviewError") <> '')

tag_suggestions_review_pair.name: tag_suggestions_review_pair
tag_suggestions_review_pair.value:
("tagSuggestions"."reviewedAt" IS NULL
           AND "tagSuggestions"."reviewVerdict" IS NULL
           AND "tagSuggestions"."model" IS NULL
           AND "tagSuggestions"."promptHash" IS NULL
           AND "tagSuggestions"."promptText" IS NULL)
          OR ("tagSuggestions"."reviewedAt" IS NOT NULL
              AND "tagSuggestions"."model" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("tagSuggestions"."model") <> ''
              AND "tagSuggestions"."promptHash" IS NOT NULL
              AND "tagSuggestions"."promptText" IS NOT NULL
              AND ("tagSuggestions"."reviewVerdict" IS NOT NULL) <> ("tagSuggestions"."reviewError" IS NOT NULL))

tag_suggestions_outcome_pair.name: tag_suggestions_outcome_pair
tag_suggestions_outcome_pair.value:
("tagSuggestions"."decision" IS NULL AND "tagSuggestions"."outcomeConceptId" IS NULL)
          OR ("tagSuggestions"."decision" = 'declined' AND "tagSuggestions"."outcomeConceptId" IS NULL)
          OR ("tagSuggestions"."decision" IN ('approved', 'merged')
              AND "tagSuggestions"."outcomeConceptId" IS NOT NULL)

term_drafts_lifecycle.name: term_drafts_lifecycle
term_drafts_lifecycle.value: ("termDrafts"."payload" IS NOT NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedDefinitionId" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedAt" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedVersion" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publication" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."deletedAt" IS NULL) OR ("termDrafts"."payload" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedDefinitionId" IS NOT NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedVersion" IS NOT NULL AND "termDrafts"."publication" IS NOT NULL AND "termDrafts"."deletedAt" IS NULL) OR ("termDrafts"."payload" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedDefinitionId" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedAt" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publishedVersion" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."publication" IS NULL AND "termDrafts"."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL)

term_metadata_source_text.name: term_metadata_source_text
term_metadata_source_text.value: ("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceLabel" IS NULL OR (btrim("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceLabel") <> '' AND char_length("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceLabel") <= 200)) AND ("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceVersion" IS NULL OR (btrim("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceVersion") <> '' AND char_length("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceVersion") <= 200 AND ("termMetadataAssertions"."sourceLabel" IS NOT NULL OR "termMetadataAssertions"."sourceIri" IS NOT NULL)))

term_metadata_review.name: term_metadata_review
term_metadata_review.value: ("termMetadataAssertions"."status" = 'proposed' AND "termMetadataAssertions"."reviewedById" IS NULL AND "termMetadataAssertions"."reviewedAt" IS NULL) OR ("termMetadataAssertions"."status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected') AND "termMetadataAssertions"."reviewedById" IS NOT NULL AND "termMetadataAssertions"."reviewedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "termMetadataAssertions"."reviewedAt" >= "termMetadataAssertions"."createdAt")

term_metadata_retraction.name: term_metadata_retraction
term_metadata_retraction.value: ("termMetadataAssertions"."retractedById" IS NULL AND "termMetadataAssertions"."retractedAt" IS NULL) OR ("termMetadataAssertions"."retractedById" IS NOT NULL AND "termMetadataAssertions"."retractedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "termMetadataAssertions"."retractedAt" >= "termMetadataAssertions"."createdAt")

terms_hidden_state_complete.name: terms_hidden_state_complete
terms_hidden_state_complete.value: ("terms"."hiddenAt" IS NULL AND "terms"."hiddenById" IS NULL AND "terms"."hiddenReason" IS NULL) OR ("terms"."hiddenAt" IS NOT NULL AND "terms"."hiddenById" IS NOT NULL AND "terms"."hiddenReason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("terms"."hiddenReason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
